title: Ukraine is using a network of drones as airborne communication relays after repeated Starlink disruptions, including during a strike on Russia's Kerch Bridge (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Ukraine is using a network of drones as airborne communication relays after repeated Starlink disruptions, including during a strike on Russia's Kerch Bridge — Kyiv starts using its own communication system for drone strikes after repeated disruptions in the use of Starlink
